//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> No Hostiles Around Campfire -> Config

Enable No Hostiles Around Campfire.//: Whether No Hostiles Around Campfire is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

preventHostilesRadius.//: The radius around the campfire in blocks where hostile mob spawns will be blocked. min: 1, max: 128

burnHostilesAroundWhenPlaced.//: If enabled, burns all hostile mobs around the campfire within the radius whenever a player places a campfire.

burnHostilesRadiusModifier.//: By default set to 0.5. This means that if the radius is 16, the campfire burns prior mobs in a radius of 8. min: 0, max: 1

preventBurningNamedHostiles.//: When enabled, hostile mobs with a custom name, like one given with a name tag, are not set on fire when a campfire is placed.

preventMobSpawnerSpawns.//: When enabled, the mob spawners spawns are also disabled when a campfire is within the radius.

campfireMustBeLit.//: When enabled, the campfire only has an effect when the block is lit up.

campfireMustBeSignalling.//: When enabled, the campfire only has an effect when the block is signalling.

campfireMustHaveSkyAccess.//: When enabled, the campfire only has an effect when nothing above it blocks the sky. This keeps campfires from clearing out caves.

enableEffectForNormalCampfires.//: When enabled, the mod will work with normal campfires.

enableEffectForSoulCampfires.//: When enabled, the mod will work with soul campfires.

entitiesToIgnore.//: Mobs that campfires never block or burn, comma separated. For example 'minecraft:pillager'. A '*' works as a wildcard, like 'alexsmobs:*'. Entity tags work too, starting with a '#', like '#minecraft:raiders'.

entitiesToTreatAsHostile.//: Mobs that count as hostile even though their mod doesn't register them as monsters, comma separated. For example 'alexsmobs:crocodile'. A '*' works as a wildcard. Entity tags work too, starting with a '#'.
